=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- changelog.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md:4-14 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment says the old judge evidence was "in-progress only" (lines 4 and 14) and that the hold covers only "queued, waiting or pending" runs on the PR head (line 7), but the shipped code does more on both counts: `_load_actions_runs_cached` merges in_progress (per_page=50), queued (per_page=50) and completed (per_page=20) runs (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18203, 18257, 18262, 18264), and the waiting selector also accepts `requested` runs and trusted PR-named dispatch runs (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22574-22581).
  WHY: scripts/assemble_changelog.py copies the fragment verbatim into CHANGELOG.md, so operators get a wrong account of the old evidence and a narrower hold scope than what ships; the last run already corrected this wording in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18626-18631, README.md:319 and agents.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md, so the fragment now contradicts them; it is a documentation defect only (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22578-22579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The waiting-run selector misses a trusted PR-named dispatch whose `head_sha` is the default-branch SHA and whose `head_branch` is null or empty, because the fallback branch check requires a non-empty `head_branch`, while the cached-run trust rule at 27941-49 accepts such a dispatch.
  WHY: For a queued trusted PR-named review dispatch with a null `head_branch`, `review_waiting_for_runner` stays false, so the deterministic hold does not prevent `escalate_human` or `close_and_reissue` (source severity MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:(no line given) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The added shell code causes a shellcheck failure.
  WHY: Code-quality issues in shell scripts, especially complex logic and piped commands, can cause unpredictable runtime behavior (source severity MAJOR); disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash report that the check-run context shows failed_count 0, that no line or check code is named, and that they found no shellcheck-violating construct.
- prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:19-20, prompts/_templates/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:12-13 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `review_waiting_for_runner` bullet says the flag means "a review run on the linked PR's current head is queued, waiting or pending for a runner", but the shipped flag (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22577-22579) is also true for `requested` runs and for trusted PR-named `workflow_dispatch` runs that carry the default-branch SHA.
  WHY: The judge reads the bullet as the flag's definition and may discount the signal when the flag is true only because of a default-branch dispatch; the effect is bounded because the prompt already tells the judge to trust the flag (source severity NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as hardening suggestions only).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- changelog.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md:4, 7, 14 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fragment contradicts the code. Line 4 says "the judge's evidence listed only in-progress runs", but `_load_actions_runs_cached` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18203, 18257, 18262) fetches in_progress (per_page=50), queued (per_page=50) and completed (per_page=20) runs. Line 7 describes only queued, waiting or pending runs on the PR head, but the widened selector (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22574-22579) also covers `requested` and trusted PR-named dispatch runs. Line 14 has the table row "| Review runs shown to the stall judge | up to 5 (was 3, in-progress only) |". The same wording was fixed at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18626-18631, in README.md and in agents.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but scripts/assemble_changelog.py copies the fragment verbatim into CHANGELOG.md, so operators get a wrong account.
- Notes (dropped pass-1 items, 4 related items): (1) The `STALL_JUDGE_LIVE_REVIEW_RUNS_ENABLED` TASK_GAP is wrong: the step starts at .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml line 1565, its env block sets the variable at line 1681, the script runs at line 1723, and all steps set it at 974, 1480, 1681, 1728, 1752, 1795. (2) The shellcheck finding was dropped: failed_count is 0, no line is named, and the editor reported a shellcheck out-of-memory. (3) scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2412 rebuilds `validate_args` on every iteration, so `--linked-pr-file` is never duplicated or left stale. (4) The `head_branch != head_ref` rule only admits trusted PR-named dispatch entries (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22528-22529).
- HARDENING: prompts/_templates/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt and prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt, `review_waiting_for_runner` bullet: the description omits `requested` and trusted PR-named dispatch runs; fix by changing the bullet to "is requested, queued, waiting or pending (or a trusted PR-named review dispatch run is)", 2 lines per file.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh unblock_ask_model, lines 2811-2823, and the `evidence: $evidence[0]` field at line 2797: when the diff read or merge fails, linked_pr.json becomes null but `evidence.linked_pr` stays in the context; fix with a one-line comment, or optionally `del(.evidence.linked_pr)`, 1-3 lines.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
